chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Mutamatti' (one performing Hajj al-Tamattu') performs Tawaf with the House and Sa'i between As-Safa and Al-Marwah as long as the people are in Mina.

key_terms.الْمُتَمَتِّعُ: Mutamatti', a pilgrim who performs Umrah first and then Hajj

ai.seo_question: When does the Mutamatti' perform Tawaf and Sa'i during Hajj?
ai.summary: In the *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to clarify the specific timing for the Mutamatti' to perform the Tawaf al-Qada and Sa'i, which occurs after returning from Mina but before the Day of Tarwiyah. This timing distinguishes the Mutamatti' from the Mufrid and Qarin, ensuring the completion of Umrah rites is integrated into the Hajj sequence while the pilgrims are still gathered in the valley of Mina. This ruling underscores the flexibility within Shia fiqh regarding the consolidation of rituals to facilitate the pilgrim's experience.
